description: This repository holds building management system data from office buildings BP201, BP205 and BP106 on Robert Bosch's Budapest campus in Hungary, collected for the AI-for-building-optimisation use case of the EU ELIAS project. It is published by Laszlo Scherman of Robert Bosch Kft. in half-year releases on Zenodo: the first covers January to June 2024 (published 1 July 2024) and the second the following half year (published 1 January 2025). The time series include temperature, humidity, air quality, pressure, flow and energy consumption, valve and damper positions, pump and fan status, control system outputs, relay states, setpoints, alarms and fault indicators, with a metadata table in Excel and Parquet. Access: monthly zip files of about 200 MB each, open download. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: point naming follows the site's building management system and needs the metadata table to interpret; three buildings on one campus. Simulation uses are data-driven HVAC control and fault detection, calibration of building energy models and digital twins of commercial buildings. Related records: the LBNL Building 59 dataset and the BIM4EEB sensor datasets.
